# Specific

Sales call analytics to drive revenue

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/specific/.

## Actions

- **Create Company**: Create a new company record in the Specific platform.
- **Create Conversation**: Create a new conversation (survey response) in the Specific platform.
- **Create or Update Company**: Upsert a company record in the Specific platform (create if not exists, update if exists).
- **Create Or Update User**: Upsert a user record in the Specific platform (creates if not exists, updates if exists).
- **Create User**: Create a new user (contact) record in the Specific platform.
- **Delete User**: Remove a user record from the Specific platform.
- **Get My Workspace** (read-only): Get current workspace information for the authenticated user.
- **List Companies** (read-only): Query company records from the Specific platform via GraphQL.
- **List Conversations** (read-only): Query conversation records (survey responses) from the Specific platform via GraphQL.
- **List Custom Fields** (read-only): Query custom field definitions in the Specific platform.
- **List Sources** (read-only): Retrieve all data sources from the Specific platform.
- **List Surveys** (read-only): Retrieve multiple survey records from the Specific platform via GraphQL.
- **List Users** (read-only): Query user accounts from the Specific platform via GraphQL.
- **Update User**: Modify an existing user record in the Specific platform via GraphQL mutation.
- **Delete Company**: Delete a company record from the Specific platform.
- **Delete Company Attributes**: Delete specific custom field attributes from a company record.
- **Delete User Attributes**: Delete specific custom field attributes from a user record in the Specific platform.
- **Update Company**: Update an existing company record in the Specific platform.
